text: Bitcoin's 1.7% decline outpaces Ethereum's 0.4% drop, suggesting selective pressure on the larger asset while altcoins hold relatively steadier ground. The Fear & Greed index at 33 reflects genuine caution, though the 8-point weekly rise indicates some stabilization of sentiment after a deeper sell-off. Bitcoin dominance climbing to 56.6% with moderate $68B daily volume points to a flight toward the largest cap asset—a typical defensive posture during uncertain conditions.
